button.name: action_mark_imported
button.confirm: Mark manually-entered lines as ready to post? Continue?

button.name: action_post_to_accounting
button.confirm: Post salary journal entries for all employees? This cannot be undone.

button.name: action_reset_to_draft
button.confirm: This will cancel and delete the linked journal entry and reset this record to Imported. Continue?

field.name: date
field.help: The date this salary sheet was imported or created. Used as the journal entry date when posting to accounting.

field.name: client_id
field.help:
The food delivery platform client this batch belongs to (e.g. HungerStation, Keeta, The Chefz).
Optional — leave blank for own internal employees.
When set, automatically fills the Analytic Account below (if the partner has a linked analytic account), enabling per-client profit tracking in analytic reports.

field.name: platform_id
field.help:
Default platform for all lines in this import.
Each platform (HungerStation, Keeta, The Chefz, etc.) has its own contract terms: fixed salary amount, minimum working days, order target, bonus per extra order, and deduction per short order.
Individual lines can override with their own platform if you have mixed-platform batches.

field.name: analytic_account_id
field.help:
Cost centre / analytic dimension applied to all journal entry lines when posting salaries.
Use this to track salary costs per branch, per client, or per project.
Priority: 1. This field (most specific) 2. Company default in Settings → Accounting Setup → Analytics tab 3. No analytic (if both are blank)
Tip: link an analytic account to the Client partner and it will fill automatically when you select a client above.

field.name: company_id
field.help: The branch company this salary batch belongs to. Determines which payroll settings, journals, and accounts are used. In a multi-branch setup, each branch processes its own riders separately.

field.name: period_start
field.help:
Start date of the payroll period covered by this batch (e.g. 01/03/2026).
Included on the salary sheet PDF for reporting and reconciliation.

field.name: period_end
field.help:
End date of the payroll period covered by this batch (e.g. 31/03/2026).
Together with Period Start, this defines the reporting window shown on the salary sheet PDF.

field.name: posting_journal_id
field.help: Journal used for the salary journal entry. Set in Settings → Payroll & Accounting Setup.

field.name: posting_expense_account_id
field.help: Account debited for each employee (salary cost). Set in Settings → Payroll & Accounting Setup.

field.name: posting_payable_account_id
field.help: Account credited for each employee (amount owed). Set in Settings → Payroll & Accounting Setup.

field.name: accounting_move_id
field.help: The journal entry created when you click Post to Accounting.

field.name: analytic_account_id
field.help: Analytic account applied to the salary expense lines for cost centre tracking.

sheet.div: Posting accounts not configured. Go to Settings → Payroll & Accounting Setup and click Auto-Setup All Accounts before posting.

field.name: platform_id
field.help:
The food delivery platform this rider worked on this month (e.g. HungerStation, Keeta).
When set alongside Valid Days and Orders Completed, clicking 'Auto-Compute' calculates: • Basic Salary (fixed tier if days ≥ min_days, else per-order rate) • Order Adjustment (bonus for extra orders, deduction for short orders)
Overrides the header-level default platform for this line only.

field.name: valid_days
field.help:
Number of valid working days the rider completed this month.
Compared against the platform's Min Days setting: • days ≥ min_days → fixed salary tier applies • days < min_days → per-order rate tier applies (basic = orders × per-order rate)

field.name: orders_completed
field.help:
Total orders delivered by this rider during the pay period.
Used to calculate the Order Adjustment: • orders > min_orders → bonus = excess × excess_order_rate • orders < min_orders → deduction = shortfall × short_order_rate • Only applies in the fixed salary tier (when valid_days ≥ min_days).

field.name: fixed_salary
field.help: Basic monthly salary. Auto-filled by platform rules or enter manually. • Fixed tier: the platform's Fixed Salary amount • Per-order tier: orders × per-order rate

field.name: order_adjustment
field.help: Order performance adjustment — positive = bonus, negative = deduction. Auto-computed: (orders_completed − min_orders) × rate.

field.name: bonus
field.help: One-time or discretionary bonus for this month. Enter manually. Added to gross earnings.

field.name: petrol_allowance
field.help: Company-paid petrol/fuel reimbursement for this rider this month. This is an earning (adds to gross), not a deduction.

field.name: gross_earnings
field.help: Auto-calculated: Basic Salary + Order Adjustment (if positive) + Bonus + Petrol Allowance. Read-only.

field.name: on_time_deduction
field.help: Deduction for late deliveries / on-time rate penalty. Enter as a positive number — it will be subtracted from gross.

field.name: food_damage_deduction
field.help: Deduction charged to the rider for damaged or spoiled food orders. Enter as a positive number. Posted to the Performance Deduction account.

field.name: miss_day_penalty
field.help: Penalty for missing a scheduled working day without approval. Enter as a positive number. Posted to the Performance Deduction account.

field.name: order_rejection_deduction
field.help: Deduction for orders rejected or cancelled by the rider. Enter as a positive number. Posted to the Performance Deduction account.

field.name: misc_deduction
field.help: Any other performance-related deduction not covered above (uniform damage, customer complaint, etc.). Enter as a positive number.

field.name: total_performance_deduction
field.help: Sum of all performance deductions: on-time + food damage + miss day + order rejection + misc. Read-only.

field.name: advance_deduction
field.help: Salary advance previously given to this rider and now being recovered. Enter the amount to deduct this month.

field.name: fuel_deduction
field.help: Fuel cost charged to the rider (e.g. company-provided fuel to be recovered). Different from Petrol Allowance — this is a deduction, not an earning.

field.name: sim_charges
field.help: SIM card / mobile data charges billed to the rider and recovered in this salary.

field.name: loan
field.help: Loan instalment being recovered this month. The full loan is tracked in the Employee Deductions ledger; this field holds only the amount to recover in this pay period.

field.name: traffic_violation
field.help: Traffic fines or violations paid by the company on the rider's behalf and recovered here.

field.name: rent
field.help: Accommodation / housing rent charged to the rider and deducted from salary.

field.name: total_office_deduction
field.help: Sum of all office deductions: advance + fuel + SIM + loan + traffic + rent. Read-only.

field.name: total_deductions
field.help: Total of all deductions: Performance Deductions + Office Deductions. Read-only.

field.name: net_payable
field.help: Amount actually paid to the rider: Gross Earnings − Total Deductions. This is the amount posted to the Salary Payable account when you click Post to Accounting.

field.name: has_error
field.help: Checked automatically if an error was found during import or posting (e.g. no active contract, employee not found). Lines with errors are skipped.

field.name: error_message
field.help: Description of the error that prevented processing for this line.

field.name: help
field.p: Import rider salary sheets from Excel, review the figures, then click Post to Accounting to create the journal entries directly. Platform rules (HungerStation, Keeta, etc.) auto-compute basic salary and order adjustments from your sheet data.
